subtitles.providersHint: Connect a provider to search and download subtitles on demand. Files are saved beside the video. Each provider applies its own limits.
subtitles.loginHint: Optional: sign in to use your account’s download allowance. Your credentials are stored locally so Theama can renew the session. Leave this blank to use the anonymous allowance.
subtitles.loggedOut: Signed out. The API key is still configured.
subtitles.setupHint: Configure a subtitle provider to start searching.
subtitles.noneExisting: No subtitles found for this video.
subtitles.downloaded: Saved {name}. Available the next time you play this video.
subtitles.chooseFile: Choose a file from this download
subtitles.noResults: No subtitles found. Try another title, language or provider.
subtitles.matchHint: Exact video matches appear first. Check the release name; timing can differ between versions.

errors.generic: Could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
errors.subtitle_not_configured: Configure this provider in Playback settings first.
errors.subtitle_auth: The provider rejected the credentials. Check your API key or sign in again.
errors.subtitle_forbidden: The provider rejected access. Check your API key and download allowance.
errors.subtitle_quota: The provider’s limit has been reached. Wait for your allowance to reset, or try another provider.
errors.subtitle_provider_unavailable: The subtitle provider is unavailable. Try again or choose another provider.
errors.subtitle_file_unavailable: The video or its drive is unavailable. Reconnect it and try again.
errors.subtitle_stale_result: This result expired or the video moved. Search again.
errors.subtitle_invalid_download: The provider returned an invalid, unsafe or unsupported subtitle download.
errors.subtitle_exists: A subtitle with this filename already exists. Your existing file has been preserved.
errors.subtitle_write_failed: Could not save the subtitle. Check the drive and folder permissions.

connection.banner: The Theama service is not responding.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.addFolderHint: Add a media folder and Theama will discover your films, series and personal videos.

home.title: Welcome to Theama
home.body: Your library is empty. Once you add folders, Continue Watching, Recently Added and more will appear here.

movies.title: No movies yet
movies.body: Point Theama at the folders that hold your films.

series.title: No series yet
series.body: Series, seasons and episodes will be grouped automatically once you add a folder.

videos.title: No personal videos yet
videos.body: Family recordings, travel clips and projects live here, untouched by movie databases.

collections.title: No collections yet
collections.body: Franchises and your own collections will appear here.

search.title: Search your library
search.body: Titles, actors, directors, genres and tags will be searchable once your library has content.

library.title: Media folders
library.description: Folders Theama keeps track of for your movies, series and personal videos. Removing a folder here never deletes anything on disk.
library.empty: No folders yet. Add the folders that hold your media.

dialog.title: Add a media folder
dialog.pathHint: A full path such as D:\Movies or \\NAS\media. For network shares use the network path, not a mapped drive letter.

typeHints.movies: Films are matched with movie databases and shown under Movies.
typeHints.series: Episodes are grouped into series, seasons and episodes.
typeHints.videos: Personal recordings. They are never matched against movie databases.
typeHints.auto: Theama decides from file names. Personal videos are never forced into a movie match.

library.offlineNote: This folder can't be reached right now. Its titles stay in your library and come back when it reconnects.
library.removeBody: Your files on disk are not touched. Titles from this folder will no longer appear in Theama.

exclusions.hint: Excluded files and subfolders stay on disk and are ignored on every scan. Remove an exclusion to show them again.

relocate.hint: Drive back under a different letter or moved? Theama follows a returning drive on its own when it can tell which one it is.
relocate.title: Change location
relocate.body: Point this folder at where it is now. Your titles, progress and collections are kept; no files are touched, and anything not found there is marked missing after the next scan.

errors.same_path: That is already this folder's location.
errors.not_found: That folder does not exist, or its drive is not connected.
errors.not_a_directory: That path is a file, not a folder.
errors.invalid_path: Enter a full folder path such as D:\Movies (no ".." parts).
errors.permission_denied: The Theama service is not allowed to read that folder. Check the account the service runs as in Settings → Advanced → Service.
errors.source_exists: That folder has already been added.
errors.unreachable: The folder could not be reached. For network shares, use the network path rather than a mapped drive letter.

scan.summary: Found {found} · {new} new · {moved} renamed or moved · {missing} missing · {errors} unreadable
scan.failed: The last scan could not finish
scan.noFiles: No video files were found in this folder.
scan.headline: Scanning your folders…
scan.headlineHint: Videos appear here as soon as the scan finishes.
scan.ffprobeMissing: FFprobe was not found, so durations, resolutions and codecs are not shown. Run "yarn ffprobe:fetch" in the project folder and restart the service.
scan.nothingOfKind: Your folders are added, but none of their videos are filed under this section. A folder's type (Movies, Series or My Videos) decides where its videos appear; you can change it in Settings → Library.

files.offlineHint: Its folder or drive is not connected right now. The title stays in your library and returns when the drive does.
files.missingHint: This file is no longer in its folder. Theama keeps it until you confirm its removal.
files.unreadableHint: FFprobe could not read this file. It may be incomplete or corrupt.
files.intro: How Theama names files when you ask it to rename them. Templates build a name from what Theama knows about the title; nothing is renamed unless you review and approve it.
files.tokenHint: A colon in a title becomes " - " and characters Windows does not allow are left out. A template names a file, not a folder.
files.historyHint: Every approved rename is recorded here. Undo puts the names back, as long as the files are still where they were left.

titles.noGenres: No genres yet. They appear once titles are identified.
titles.genreAnyHint: Titles with at least one of the chosen genres

select.hidden: Hid {count} title. Restore it from Library exclusions. | Hid {count} titles. Restore them from Library exclusions.
select.moveConfirmTitle: Change this title's category? | Change the category of these titles?
select.moveConfirmBody: This changes the category of {count} selected title(s) to {destination}. Files stay where they are on disk. Provider matches will be detached and may need to be identified again.
select.groupedIdentified: Grouped {count} file(s) into one series and identified it.
select.groupedUnidentified: Grouped {count} file(s) into one series, but it could not be identified: {reason}

titles.hideHint: Hide this title and exclude its files from future scans
titles.hidden: {title} hidden. You can restore it from Settings → Library → Exclusions.
titles.partlyHint: Some files of this title are not available right now.

actions.fileUnavailable: This file is offline or missing
actions.hideHint: Keep its data and restore it from Library exclusions
actions.removeFromContinueHint: Your watched history is kept. It returns when you play it again.
actions.failed: The action could not be completed.
actions.moveConfirmBody: This changes the category for {count} file(s) to {destination}. Files stay where they are on disk. The title's provider match will be detached and may need to be identified again.
actions.removeConfirmBody: The {count} file(s) stay untouched on disk. Theama will remove the metadata match, watched history, and user-collection links. Restoring the exclusion later will not restore that data.
actions.removed: Removed {title} from Theama ({count} file(s) left untouched).

detail.switchPathAria: Switch the file used for {name} ({n} paths)
detail.gone: This title is no longer in your library
detail.goneHint: Its folder may have been removed from Theama.
detail.trailerYoutubeHint: Open the trailer on YouTube in your browser
detail.openTmdb: Open this title on TMDB in your browser
detail.openTmdbRating: {rating}. Open this title on TMDB in your browser
detail.otherAvailableTitles: Other available titles in your library
detail.noOtherTitles: No other available movies or series with this person are in your library.

search.label: Search your library
search.hint: Titles, episode names and file names. Accents and capital letters don't matter.

recovery.title: Theama cannot reach its background service
recovery.body: Your library and settings are safe on disk. The service that manages them is not responding.
recovery.notInstalled: The Theama service is not installed on this computer.
recovery.stopped: The Theama service is installed but stopped.
recovery.startingUp: The service is starting. This usually takes a few seconds.
recovery.running: The service reports it is running, but its API is not answering.
recovery.devProcess: Development mode: the backend runs as a normal process.
recovery.noLogs: No log files were found yet.
recovery.needsDesktop: Open Theama from the desktop application to manage the service.

backdrop.title: Backdrop scene
backdrop.hint: Pick the 3D scene behind the app. Classic is the default. Automatic changes the scene with what you are looking at.

auto.name: Automatic
auto.hint: Follows the genre, and whether you are in movies or series.

backdrop.byGenreHint: A horror film gets the horror scene, a comedy the comedy scene, and so on.
backdrop.byKindHint: Movies, series and My videos each get their own scene when no genre applies.
backdrop.autoOnly: These apply when Automatic is selected.

classic.name: Classic
classic.hint: Dust, soft light and drifting posters.

movie.name: Cinema
movie.hint: A projector beam over a slow carousel of posters.

series.name: Episode wall
series.hint: Columns of cards drifting up and down in cool screen light.

horror.name: Horror
horror.hint: Red fog and a flickering dark.

romance.name: Romance
romance.hint: Drifting petals and soft rose light.

scifi.name: Sci-fi
scifi.hint: A nebula over a glowing grid.

western.name: Western
western.hint: Warm dust and a low sun.

general.themeHint: System follows your Windows appearance setting.
general.textSizeHint: Applies immediately throughout the app. Text also grows automatically in larger windows. Choose Default to reset.
general.textSizePreview: Find your next favourite film, series, or memory.
general.visualModeHint: Immersive adds an animated 3D backdrop and depth effects to posters. It needs a working graphics card.
general.graphicsQualityHint: Lower this if the animation feels slow. The app also lowers it by itself when needed.

immersiveUnavailable.webgl: 3D graphics are not available on this computer, so the standard interface is used.
immersiveUnavailable.motion: Windows is set to reduce animations, so the standard interface is used.

general.logRetentionHint: Older log files are deleted automatically.
general.logDetailHint: How much Theama writes to its log history. Normal is right for everyday use; choose Detailed only while looking for a problem, because it makes the logs much larger. It applies at once.

about.diagnosticsHint: If something goes wrong, copy this report and paste it where you are asking for help. It lists versions, what is running and recent warnings and errors. It contains file paths but never your API token or TMDB key, and nothing is sent anywhere.
about.reportFailed: The report could not be made.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.closeToTray: Keep Theama in the notification area when I close the window
desktop.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window hides it; use the Theama icon near the clock to open it again, or Quit to exit. The background service runs either way.
desktop.startWithWindows: Start Theama when I sign in to Windows
desktop.startWithWindowsHint: It starts in the notification area if the option above is on, otherwise it opens its window.
desktop.startWithWindowsDev: Only the installed app can start with Windows.

service.title: Background service
service.description: Theama keeps your library up to date in a Windows service that keeps running when this window is closed.
service.elevation: Installing, repairing or removing the service asks Windows for administrator permission once. Starting and stopping afterwards does not.

install.title: Install the Theama service
install.currentUserHint: Keeps your file permissions and network shares. Windows asks for your password once.
install.localSystemHint: No password needed, but file operations run with full system rights and network shares need extra setup.
install.uninstallBody: Your library database, settings and logs stay on disk. You can install the service again at any time.

service.needsDesktop: Service controls are available in the Theama desktop application.

logs.title: Log history
logs.description: Everything the background service has recorded, newest first.
logs.serviceOutputNote: Service output files have no timestamps of their own; the file's last write time is shown.
logs.error: Could not load the log history.

errors.network: Could not reach the Theama backend.
errors.unauthorized: The backend rejected this app's credentials.

match.notIdentifiedHint: Theama could not settle what this is. Open it to choose.
match.ambiguousHint: Theama found possible matches but was not sure enough to pick one for you.
match.unmatchedHint: Nothing close enough was found. You can search by another name.
match.clearedHint: You cleared the match. Theama will leave this title alone until you pick something.
match.noKey: Add a free TMDB key to get posters, summaries and cast.
match.attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

errors.no_key: Add a TMDB key in Settings first.
errors.provider_unavailable: TMDB cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

dialog.title: Identify this title
dialog.subtitle: Theama read “{name}” from your files.
dialog.none: No results. Try a shorter or different name.
dialog.lockNote: Your choice is locked: rescans and refreshes will not change it.
dialog.groupSubtitle: {count} title will become one series. | {count} titles will become one series.
dialog.groupNameHint: Files grouped under this name join the same series, including one you already have.

tools.heading: VPN and download apps

vpn.unsupported: VPN checks are unavailable on this platform

tools.warning: qBittorrent may be running without a verified VPN connection. Open NordVPN and connect to a server.
tools.remoteWarning: The local NordVPN connection cannot verify protection for a remote qBittorrent instance.

reason.verified: The tunnel and NordVPN protection check passed.
reason.no_tunnel: No active NordVPN tunnel with a valid network address was found.
reason.unsupported_tunnel: No supported NordLynx or NordVPN OpenVPN adapter was found. Check the connection in NordVPN.
reason.route_mismatch: Internet routing could not be confirmed through the NordVPN tunnel.
reason.protection_failed: NordVPN's online protection check did not confirm the connection.
reason.check_failed: The connection check failed. Open NordVPN to check its status, or try again.
reason.unsupported_platform: Automatic connection checks require the Windows desktop app.
reason.stale: Waiting for a current connection check. Previous results have expired.
reason.remote: This qBittorrent address is not local to this PC. Check the VPN on the computer running qBittorrent.

error.not_installed: The app was not found in its usual installation folders. Install it there, or open it manually.
error.launch_failed: The app could not be opened. Try opening it from the Windows Start menu.
error.not_ready: The app has not finished starting. Check its window, then try again.
error.unavailable: Opening download apps requires the Windows desktop app.
error.invalid_address: Prowlarr's address is invalid. Set an HTTP or HTTPS address without an embedded username or password in Downloads Settings.

tools.splitTunneling: This checks the VPN connection on this PC, not qBittorrent's individual traffic. NordVPN split tunneling can exclude apps; make sure qBittorrent is included in the VPN connection. Checks are advisory and do not pause or block downloads.
tools.desktopOnly: Use the Windows desktop app to check NordVPN and open download apps.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: Theama can hand downloads to qBittorrent and look for releases of the movies and series you want. It never downloads anything itself: qBittorrent does, and finished files appear in your library when they land in one of its folders.
downloads.usernameHint: Optional. Leave the user name and password empty if qBittorrent skips authentication for this computer (Web UI → Bypass authentication for clients on localhost).
downloads.passwordHint: Kept on this PC only and never shown again. Leave empty if qBittorrent does not ask for one on this computer.
downloads.badAddress: This is not a valid http:// or https:// address.

qb.name: qBittorrent
qb.intro: The program that does the downloading. Theama talks to its Web UI.
qb.rejected: qBittorrent did not accept this user name or password.
qb.webUiHint: In qBittorrent, turn on Tools → Options → Web UI → Web User Interface (Remote control). The login is checked before it is kept.

prowlarr.name: Prowlarr
prowlarr.intro: Optional, and recommended: Prowlarr searches many torrent sites at once and gives better results than qBittorrent's own search plugins. Without it, the plugins installed in qBittorrent are used.
prowlarr.apiKeyHint: In Prowlarr: Settings → General → API Key.
prowlarr.rejected: Prowlarr did not accept this API key.

folders.title: Where downloads are saved
folders.hint: Pick one of your library folders for each kind, so finished downloads show up in Theama by themselves. Leave it on the default to use qBittorrent's own folder.

downloads.privacyText: Your title searches go to Prowlarr or qBittorrent, which pass them to the torrent sites you chose there. Theama bundles no sites or plugins, and you are responsible for what you download. Passwords and keys are stored in the secrets folder of Theama's data, not in its database.

find.label: Title
find.noMatches: TMDB found nothing for this search.
find.noKey: Add a TMDB key in Settings → Metadata to see suggestions.
find.setup: Set up qBittorrent or Prowlarr first to search for releases.

favorites.empty: Save titles using the heart button to find them here later.
favorites.noneOfKind: No favorites of this type yet.
favorites.error: Could not update favorites or library status: {message}

releases.title: Search the torrents for…
releases.filteredOut: No release passes the filters. Lower the seeders or pick another resolution.
releases.expired: This search has expired. Search again.
releases.nothingReceived: The search came back empty: {source} returned no results at all. Check that its sites or plugins are working (in qBittorrent: View → Search Engine → Search plugins, and try the same search there).
releases.noneMatched: {count} results came back, but none looked like this title, so they were hidden. Try another spelling or add the year.

active.heading: Your downloads
active.unreachable: qBittorrent is not answering, so progress cannot be shown. Is it running, with its Web UI on?
active.keepFiles: Remove from the list, keep the files
active.confirmDeleteBody: “{name}” and what was downloaded of it will be deleted from the disk. This cannot be undone.

files.title: Files in this download
files.intro: Untick the files you do not want. They are skipped and take no space; files already downloaded stay on disk.
files.fetching: qBittorrent is still fetching the details of this torrent. The list appears here as soon as it has them.
files.needOne: Keep at least one file. To stop the download altogether, remove it instead.

metadata.intro: Theama can fetch posters, summaries, cast and episode names from TMDB. It works without this; titles then show the generated artwork and what is in the file names.
metadata.keyLabel: TMDB API key or read access token
metadata.keyHint: Either kind works. It is checked with TMDB before it is kept.
metadata.howToGet: To get one for free: create an account at themoviedb.org, then open Settings → API in your account.
metadata.keySaved: A key is saved. It is stored on this PC only and is never shown again.
metadata.keyRejected: TMDB did not accept this key.
metadata.unavailable: TMDB cannot be reached. Your library keeps working; Theama will try again.
metadata.rejected: TMDB rejected the saved key. Replace it to continue.
metadata.countsHint: Personal videos are never looked up.
metadata.languageHint: Titles, summaries and genres are requested in this language. Anything TMDB has no translation for is shown in English. This is separate from the language of the app.
metadata.privacyText: Only the title text and year Theama guessed (for example “Severance”, 2022) and the id of a title you identified. File names, folder paths and anything about personal videos stay on this PC.

nudge.title: Make your library look the part
nudge.body: Add a free TMDB key to get posters, summaries and cast.

series.undatedHint: TMDB has no air date for this episode, so Theama cannot say whether it is missing.
series.strayHint: TMDB does not list this season and episode number for the series. The file is kept and still shown.

new.title: New collection
new.name: Name
new.duplicate: You already have a collection with that name.
new.withTitle: This title will be the first one in it.

collections.emptyBody: Sets such as film series appear here once their titles are identified. You can also make your own from any title page.
collections.goneHint: It may have been deleted. Your titles are untouched.
collections.officialNote: Titles you do not have are listed so you can see what is missing. They cannot be played. Theama shows release order only: story order needs curated data and is never guessed.
collections.emptyCollection: Nothing in this collection yet. Open a title and choose Add to collection.
collections.deleteBody: Only the collection is deleted. The titles and their files stay where they are.

play.unavailable: Not available right now: the drive is offline or the file has moved.
play.needsApp: Playing needs the Theama desktop app
play.needsAppHint: Videos are opened in your media player by the desktop app. In a browser tab Theama can only browse.
play.noPlayer: That player is not available on this PC. Choose another in Settings → Playback.
play.failed: The player could not be started.
play.nextUpIn: Starting {label} in {seconds} second | Starting {label} in {seconds} seconds

playback.intro: Theama opens your videos in the media player you choose. It starts the player on the file (with a subtitle in your preferred language when one sits next to the video) and keeps track of what you mark as watched.
playback.systemHint: Whatever Windows opens video files with
playback.noSubtitleHint: Theama can start this player on the video, but cannot hand it a subtitle file. Embedded subtitles still work.
playback.playersHint: VLC, MPC-HC, MPC-BE, mpv and PotPlayer are found automatically. Only programs you pick here are ever started, and always with the video as an argument — never through a command line.
playback.subtitleHint: When you play something, Theama looks next to the video (and in Subs or Subtitles folders) for a subtitle file in the first of these languages and hands it to the player. Forced-only subtitles are never chosen.
playback.autoNextHint: When an episode ends, Theama comes to the front and starts the next one after a short countdown. You can cancel it or play right away. Episodes opened in MPC-HC and MPC-BE close their player automatically when they finish. Automatic next episode works with the players Theama can follow: VLC, mpv, MPC-HC and MPC-BE.
playback.trackingText: With VLC, mpv, MPC-HC and MPC-BE, Theama sees how far you got. Stop after at least 5 minutes and it remembers the minute and carries on from there next time; from 90% of the runtime the episode or film counts as watched and Continue watching moves on to the next episode. Other players are only remembered as started: mark those as watched yourself (per episode, season or title).
playback.trackedHint: Theama can see how far you got in this player

rename.title: Rename files
rename.lead: Review the new names. Nothing changes until you press Rename, every rename is written to a history you can undo, and a name that is already taken is never overwritten.
rename.tokens: You can use: {tokens}. Add :00 to pad a number, for example {example}.
rename.nothing: There are no files to rename here.
rename.subtitle: Subtitle
rename.nothingChanged: Nothing was renamed: the files changed since the preview. Open it again.
rename.failedSome: {n} could not be renamed and were left as they were.
rename.undone: Put {n} file back. | Put {n} files back.
rename.undoneSome: {n} could not be put back because they changed since.
rename.safety: Files are renamed where they are: never moved, deleted or overwritten. Subtitles that share the video's name are renamed with it. A player that has the file open can stop a rename.

statusHint.unchanged: This file already has the name the template gives it.
statusHint.collision_exists: Something in this folder already has the new name, so this file is left alone.
statusHint.collision_batch: Two files in this rename would get the same name, so neither is renamed. Change the template or the titles.
statusHint.too_long: The new path would be too long for Windows.
statusHint.unavailable: Its drive is not connected, so it cannot be renamed now.
statusHint.missing: Theama cannot find this file where it expected it.
statusHint.skipped: An episode needs a season and an episode number to be named by this template.
statusHint.changed: This file changed since the preview.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.intro: Your library lives in a database on this PC: which titles are identified, your collections, what you have watched, your settings and the rename history. Theama keeps a copy once a day and before any upgrade. Your video files are never part of it.
backup.deleteBody: Only the backup file is deleted. Your library is not affected.
backup.what: A backup holds the library database only. Artwork is downloaded again when needed, and the TMDB key is not included, so a backup is safe to keep or share.
backup.confirmBody: Your library data (identifications, collections, watched marks, settings, rename history) will be replaced by what the backup holds. Changes made since will be lost. The service has to restart to do it.
backup.confirmSafe: The current state is saved first as a “before a restore” backup, and your video files are not touched.
backup.pendingBody: “{source}” ({files} files, {titles} titles) will replace the library when the service restarts.
backup.restartByHand: Restart the Theama service to apply it.
